visitors.name: Marcus Vane
dialogue_chain: Knock. A single fist, steady.
Name: Marcus Vane. Claims he lives downstairs.
visitors.reveal_on_inspection: His neck has two fresh puncture marks, already darkening.

visitors.name: Elena and Leo
dialogue_chain: A woman with a boy, both shivering.
Name: Elena. Her son Leo is asthmatic; she begs for shelter.
visitors.reveal_on_inspection: Leo's inhaler is genuine. Elena keeps checking the street.

visitors.name: Arthur Pendelton
dialogue_chain: An old man, immaculate suit, cane.
Name: Arthur Pendelton. Asks to use your phone.
visitors.reveal_on_inspection: Pocket watch shows a family photo; hands tremor with age, not infection.

visitors.name: Sgt. Sergei Volkov
dialogue_chain: Boots on the landing. Heavy breathing.
Name: Sergeant Volkov. Municipal enforcement.
visitors.reveal_on_inspection: Under the cap, his temple is veined black. He avoids mirrors.

visitors.name: Martha Gillespie
dialogue_chain: A neighbor with a casserole dish.
Name: Martha. Wants to check on you.
visitors.reveal_on_inspection: The casserole smells normal. Her pupils are fine.

visitors.name: Toby Renner
dialogue_chain: A teenager, restless, hood up.
Name: Toby Renner. Says his sister is missing.
visitors.reveal_on_inspection: When he turns, the hood slips: his jaw is split wrong, healing too fast.

visitors.name: Trio: Conrad, Mira, Sam
dialogue_chain: Three people, too close, speaking in turns.
Names: Conrad, Mira, Sam. They say the block is being evacuated.
visitors.reveal_on_inspection: They blink in unison. Sam's reflection lags behind his head.

visitors.name: Veronica Reyes
dialogue_chain: A nurse in stained scrubs.
Name: Veronica Reyes. Offers vaccine samples.
visitors.reveal_on_inspection: The vials are empty. Her gloves hide nails grown into points.

visitors.name: Dr. Evelyn Thorne
dialogue_chain: A doctor with a flashlight and a satchel.
Name: Dr. Thorne. Needs to document survivors.
visitors.reveal_on_inspection: Credentials check out. She carries antibiotics, not a weapon.

visitors.name: Julian Vance
dialogue_chain: A man who looks like Marcus, but older.
Name: Julian Vance. Looking for his brother.
visitors.reveal_on_inspection: Family resemblance is real. He's clean, but desperate.

visitors.name: Clara Doppelganger
dialogue_chain: A woman wearing your face.
Name: Clara. Says she lives in apartment 4B.
visitors.reveal_on_inspection: Her teeth are too many. She copied your voice from the hallway.

visitors.name: Father Thomas
dialogue_chain: A priest with soot on his collar.
Name: Father Thomas. Offers last rites and a candle.
visitors.reveal_on_inspection: No infection markers. His rosary is warm from prayer.

visitors.name: Cadet Mia
dialogue_chain: A young cadet, uniform torn.
Name: Mia. Requests backup radio access.
visitors.reveal_on_inspection: Radio works; she calls in a real unit number. Clean.

visitors.name: Jax Corvin
dialogue_chain: A courier with a sealed envelope.
Name: Jax Corvin. Delivering evacuation orders.
visitors.reveal_on_inspection: Envelope is real, wax seal intact. No signs of infection.

visitors.name: Hannah Cross
dialogue_chain: A woman in a hazmat suit, visor up.
Name: Hannah Cross. Needs to test your blood.
visitors.reveal_on_inspection: Equipment is genuine. She shows you her own clean result first.

visitors.name: Gideon Vance
dialogue_chain: A gaunt man claiming to be the Vance patriarch.
Name: Gideon Vance. Warns you against opening the door.
visitors.reveal_on_inspection: Old, lucid, unarmed. His advice matches the radio bulletin.

visitors.name: Lily Cooper
dialogue_chain: A child's silhouette behind frosted glass.
Name: Lily Cooper. Asks if her mommy is home.
visitors.reveal_on_inspection: The silhouette is too tall. The voice is recorded, looping.

visitors.name: Richard Vance (Hazmat)
dialogue_chain: A hazmat officer with no unit patch.
Name: Richard Vance. Demands entry for decontamination.
visitors.reveal_on_inspection: No patch, no badge. But his scanner beeps negative on himself.

visitors.name: Kane Blackwood
dialogue_chain: A drifter with a transistor radio.
Name: Kane Blackwood. Tunes between stations.
visitors.reveal_on_inspection: Radio picks up a real emergency broadcast. He's just tired.

visitors.name: Nadia Volkova
dialogue_chain: A woman in uniform, similar to Sergei.
Name: Nadia Volkova. Claims Sergei was her brother.
visitors.reveal_on_inspection: She weeps black. The veins on her neck match his exactly.
